answer: Identity bonds decay unless renewed by honest work. Each agent locks a $40 bond for weight 1.0, a velvet rope for members. Weight falls 5% per epoch, restored only by verified tasks; honest agents wander job to job and stay full. Below 0.2, voting ends. Forging 1,000 locks $40,000 and needs 1,000 verified tasks each epoch, or they fade like a zephyr in 20 epochs. Bought identities reset to zero. One honest agent pays $40 once, keeps its share.
